content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes ceiling and wall building products for commercial interiors, not roadway, vegetation, agriculture or construction machinery."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Shares road contractor customers, but its asphalt plants, crushers and drills differ from Alamo's sweepers, mowers and farm equipment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Makes roofing membranes, insulation and coatings, a building envelope business unlike Alamo's mobile equipment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Makes roof coatings, HVAC components and industrial valves, not roadway or vegetation equipment."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds agricultural tillage and harvesting, mowers and construction machines sold through dealers to farmers, contractors and municipalities."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes pool and spa pumps, filters and heaters sold to pool builders and homeowners."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Makes heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment for buildings, unrelated to Alamo's equipment lines."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Makes roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber, a building materials business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Makes structural connectors, anchors and fasteners for building construction, not mobile equipment."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Builds commercial mowers, turf equipment and underground construction machines sold through dealers to landscapers and municipalities."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Builds recreational vehicles and buses sold to consumers and dealers, a different vehicle business."}]}
